name: Ruins of Lordaeron

entrance.note: Forever-only dungeon in the ruins above the Undercity, Tirisfal Glades. Entrance 66.0, 11.0 is reported (gamer-guides.com) and used by steps-v2; verified: false. Horde access is from Undercity.

travel.how: From Brill or the Undercity, go up into the ruins above the city; grab Morbin in Undercity and Tabitha at the Sepulcher before you enter.

quests.name: Light's Justice
quests.notes: Collect 25 Intact Limbs inside on this one clear. QuestieDB v1.1.3 has no xp field. verified: false. foreverConfidence high (traces, wowheadForever).

quests.name: The New Plague
quests.notes: Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang inside. Requires A Recipe For Death 451. Pickup is spliced after silverpine-11-15:w2-451-3 for Undead. Kalimdor races have not done 451, so the prereq guard skips it for them.

quests.name: The Wrath of Rath'mael
quests.notes: Kill Rath'mael inside. Requires Rear Guard Patrol 99156. Pickup is spliced after tirisfal-1-12:w2-99156-3 for Undead. Kalimdor races have not done 99156.

quests.name: A Frightened Request
quests.notes: Investigate Edward Heartweaver inside. Silverpine tips this pickup and does not enter; the clear belongs here. XP unknown (0). Pick up only if it is not already in the log.

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.notes: Accept if the Abominable Head drops on this clear; do not reset for it. First of five Unending Torment steps (97288-97292). QuestieDB has no xp on this starter. Leads to 97289.

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.notes: Bring the Head of the Baron to Othmar's body (npc 271613). Undercity follow-up, not inside the dungeon. Catalog listed the chain as one row; steps-v2 expands 97289-97292. XP 1650 from questie-db.

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.notes: Report back to Faranell. XP 1650 from questie-db.

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.notes: City errand: Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette (Trade Quarter 65.19, 49.84), Blisterweed near Katrina Alliestar / Martha (54.73, 48.92), Essence of Agony from Ezekiel Graves (Rogues' Quarter 75.2, 51.18). XP 1650.

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.notes: Inject the Hissing Serum into object 460007 above Othmar's body. Questie-db has no object spawn; pin npc 271613 at 45.88, 61.7. Chain ends here. XP 1650.

quests.name: Crest of Lordaeron
quests.notes: Accept only if the crest drops on this clear. exclusiveTo 95189 (95189 is not in the Horde questie import). XP unknown (0).

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 15-20; do not enter before 18 (runAt).
warnings: Grab 92421 from Morbin Lightbane in Undercity before entering.
Grab 92401 from Tabitha Heartweaver at the Sepulcher if it is not already in the log.
Skip 95216 unless A Recipe For Death 451 is already complete.
Skip 92422 unless Rear Guard Patrol 99156 is already complete; do not start that elite chain for this run.
Loot 25 Intact Limbs on this one clear; do not extra-pull or reset if short.
97288 and 95204 are item drops; take them if they drop, do not reset.
Unending Torment 97289-97292 are Undercity follow-ups after the run, not a second dungeon entry.
At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour on Forever; kill XP inside is increased, and the party gets no XP if any member is too high.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: nova/v2/silverpine-11-15 is balanced-only (speedrun skips the whole road). RoL at 18 is the Undead dungeon alternative to those Sepulcher quests.

A Recipe For Death 447-451 is the slow elite/drop chain in the nova 1-24 catalog (the live silverpine pack dropped it). It is also the prereq of 95216, so skipping that chain is the same decision as skipping The New Plague.

sourceConflicts: Entrance 66.0, 11.0 is reported (gamer-guides.com / steps-v2) and verified: false; not from Questie dungeon pins.
95216 and 92422 are in dungeons.json, README, and TUGs/WoW-Pro Forever; steps-v2 omits them (451 and 99156 prereq chains were refused in the 1-20 packs).
99156 Rear Guard Patrol is races 18 (Orc+Undead), while 92422 is the full Horde mask in questie-db.
Catalog lists six Horde quests and says later Unending Torment steps are not listed separately; steps-v2 and questie-db expand 97289-97292 as Undercity follow-ups with 1650 XP each.
XP is missing in questie-db for 92421, 95216, 92422, 92401, 97288, and 95204; left at 0. Did not invent Classic XP for this Forever dungeon.
All Forever quests remain verified: false until checked in game.
notes: Forever-only dungeon (Blizzard level range 15-20). Do not invent Classic quests for it. Quest ids, givers, and Forever-frame coords from content/questie-db (QuestieDB v1.1.3). 79953 and 81951 are not used. One balanced clear; speedrun already skips RFC/WC in 1-20 and treats RoL the same.
